title: What happens when valid scopes disagree?
question: When valid project, branch, and purpose rules disagree, how should TurtleBlock represent the conflict without inventing precedence?
why_now: Session-boundary carryover is now testable; conflicting scoped rules are the next unresolved boundary.
possible_possibles: Do less until the learner names precedence.
x_factor: whoooo knooooowwwssssssssssss — what if the safest resolver is to do less until a human names the scope that matters?

ctc_mappings.rationale: Conflicting rules can be inspected and revised.

uncaptured_residue.observation: Valid-scope conflict may need first-class representation.
